official.status_note: The 2026 application windows and the March 25, 2026 CSC deadline have passed; the ISO page publishes no new dates.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Exemption from tuition fee about one year, providing free on-campus accommodation or providing accommodation subsidy, Comprehensive Medical Insurance
benefits: Exemption from tuition fee about one year
Free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy
eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens under the age of 45, in good health
Holders of a bachelor's degree or above with work experience of three years or above; applicants with professional study or work background related to the applied project are preferred

One of four professional categories: public officials at division level (or corresponding level) or above; senior managers of institutions and enterprises; administrative personnel of universities and scientific research institutions; personnel with relevant experience in international organizations or internships
Not holding any other scholarship provided by the Chinese government
Must secure pre-admission from Fudan before applying on the CSC portal
requirements: Register at the eligible programme as a self-support student and complete the Fudan online application
Email the scholarship-intent notice with the Fudan application number (beginning with C20260902)
Obtain the pre-admission letter, then apply on the CSC website before March 25, 2026
documents: Photocopy of valid ordinary passport (valid after March 1, 2027; plus the visa or residence-permit page if currently residing in China)
Notarised highest diploma (or official proof of impending graduation) and notarised transcripts, with notarised Chinese/English translation where the original is not in Chinese or English
Two recommendation letters in Chinese or English, signed by a professor or associate professor
Personal statement written in Chinese covering study and work experience, academic achievement, expected research proposal and career plan
Language certificate and score report (TOEFL above 90, IELTS above 6.5, etc.)

Proof of No Criminal Record, Proof of Financial Capacity or the Statement of Financial Support, Foreigner Physical Examination Form (valid six months), and one of the four professional identity documents
selection_criteria: University approval and issue of a pre-admission letter by Fudan
Final award decision by the Chinese Scholarship Council
Applicants who have not won scholarships can choose to study as self-support students
coverage: Exemption from tuition fee about one year
Free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy
application_method: Register at https://istudent.fudan.edu.cn/apply, choose the FLS LL.M. Program in Chinese Business Law or the Master Program of Public Administration as a self-support student, upload the required documents and complete the online application
Email fudanllm@fudan.edu.cn (LL.M.) or igppadmin@fudan.edu.cn (MPA), cc cym@fudan.edu.cn, stating the willingness to apply and giving the Fudan application number
Pay the 800 RMB application fee online

After the pre-admission letter, apply at http://www.campuschina.org before March 25, 2026: Program Category Type A, Agency No. 1563, program Youth of Excellence Scheme of China Program Chinese Government Scholarship Program, Major Civil Law or Public Management, Teaching Language English
Combine the identity certificate and pre-admission letter into one PDF and upload it to the pre-admission letter column
official.application_route: Apply to the eligible master's programme at istudent.fudan.edu.cn as a self-support student, email your scholarship intent, then file on the CSC portal (Type A, Agency No. 1563) after the pre-admission letter.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens, under the age of 45
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Only the FLS LL.M. Program in Chinese Business Law or the Master Program of Public Administration (Master in Global Public Policy; International Master of Public Administration)
official.research_requirement: The personal statement must include an expected research proposal; a study plan or research proposal is required under the CSC application rules
official.description: A Chinese Government Scholarship programme implemented by the Management Committee of the China Scholarship Council to cultivate global governance talents with broad international vision, excellent comprehensive quality, leadership and cross-cultural background, delivered through Fudan's LL.M. and public-administration master's programmes.
official.program_type: Chinese Government Scholarship - Youth of Excellence Scheme of China Program
official.english_requirement: TOEFL above 90, IELTS above 6.5, etc. (language certificate and score report are required); the CSC application is filed with Teaching Language English

applicant_utility.summary: This is the Chinese Government Scholarship's Youth of Excellence Scheme delivered through Fudan's LL.M. in Chinese Business Law and its Master of Public Administration, and it targets mid-career professionals rather than fresh graduates - three years of work experience and a senior professional profile are mandatory. You first apply to the programme as a self-support student, email Fudan your scholarship intent, and only after the pre-admission letter do you file on the CSC portal under Type A, Agency No. 1563. The award brings a 3,000 RMB monthly stipend for master's students plus tuition exemption, accommodation and medical insurance, but note the tuition exemption runs for about one year, matching the one-year master's format.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mid-career officials, managers and university administrators under 45 who want an English-taught master's in law or public policy in Shanghai.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you sit in one of the four eligible professional categories before anything else
Count your work experience - three years minimum, and it must be documented
Plan the Chinese-language personal statement early; it must cover study and work history, academic achievement, research proposal and career plan
Line up two referees who are professors or associate professors
Make sure your passport stays valid beyond March 1, 2027
Keep proof of financial capacity and a recent physical examination ready (the form is valid six months)
common_rejection_risks: Not meeting the professional-category test - a fresh graduate cannot qualify regardless of grades
Applying only on the CSC portal without the Fudan pre-admission letter, or reversing the order of the steps
Uploading the identity certificate separately instead of merged with the pre-admission letter into one PDF
A personal statement not written in Chinese
Expired passport or an out-of-date physical examination form
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The 800 RMB application fee, international travel and personal spending on top of the 3,000 RMB monthly stipend.
document_audit: Identity proof and the pre-admission letter must be a single combined PDF in the pre-admission column
Recommendation letters can be uploaded by you or completed online by the recommender via a link - coordinate early
The Foreigner Physical Examination Form lapses after six months; applicants already in China can use a residence permit or PRC permanent-resident ID instead
TOEFL/IELTS must clear 90/6.5 or an accepted equivalent
alerts: You cannot hold any other Chinese government scholarship - concealment means cancellation and a three-year application ban
New scholarship students must participate in annual evaluation; failing it cancels the award
The major and study period cannot be changed after enrolment
If the scholarship is not won, the self-support place remains - the programme keeps running fee-paying
If you are found to hold PRC nationality, admission qualification and enrolment status are cancelled
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Fudan application first (self-support), scholarship-intent email with the application number, pre-admission letter, then the CSC portal application with the combined PDF; the Chinese Scholarship Council makes the final award decision.
